inputs.prompt: Requested framing: Close-up. Edit the reference photograph into a new camera shot of the SAME scene. Preserve the exact same person and facial identity, hair, outfit, bag, object design, materials, lighting and set architecture from the reference. Change camera position and framing as requested; do not simply repeat the reference composition. TIGHT FACE CLOSE-UP photograph of the same fictional adult woman from the reference, exact lowered gaze, rounded face, right side part, light chestnut chin-length bob with loose waves and outward-fanning ends, mustard canvas coat with metal buttons and flap chest pockets, shoulder tabs and chunky rich teal cable-knit scarf with dense compact twisted cables and rolled neck loop. This is a camera push-in, not a restyling. Whole head outline visible, including outward-curling jaw-level tips on both sides. Preserve wave clumps, original forehead, brow spacing, nose, relaxed closed lips and face proportions. Crop just above the head to the upper teal cable-knit loop, no chest, hands or compass. Rainy greenhouse window grid softly blurred. Keep same diffuse daylight.. Keep only elements visible in this framing; do not force a face into a detail or rear view.
